overview: This paper proposes a conditioned initialization strategy for Transformer attention layers that initializes query and key matrices as semi-orthogonal projections and value matrices as rectangular identities to reduce the condition number of the attention Jacobian, thereby accelerating convergence and improving generalization across vision, language, and sequence tasks.

modules.name: Vision Data Processing and Loading
modules.description: Handles data loading, format conversion, and standard image augmentation strategies for large-scale image classification datasets and small-scale fine-tuning datasets, as well as preprocessing for object detection and instance segmentation datasets.

modules.name: Language and Sequence Data Processing and Loading
modules.description: Manages tokenization, sequence padding, and dynamic batching for long-range sequence modeling benchmarks, as well as preprocessing and encoding for masked language modeling and autoregressive language modeling datasets.

modules.name: Conditioned Initialization Implementation
modules.description: Implements the core proposed initialization scheme, generating semi-orthogonal matrices for queries and keys via truncated SVD or QR decomposition, and constructing rectangular identity matrices for values to ensure minimal initial condition numbers.

modules.name: Baseline Initialization Implementations
modules.description: Implements standard default initialization routines and alternative heuristic approaches like mimetic initialization to serve as rigorous comparison baselines against the proposed conditioned initialization.

modules.name: Theoretical Bound Computation
modules.description: Calculates the surrogate upper bound of the self-attention Jacobian's condition number as derived in the theoretical framework, utilizing the condition numbers of the input representations, weight matrices, and intermediate softmax components.

modules.name: Empirical Jacobian Condition Number Computation
modules.description: Computes the actual condition number of the self-attention Jacobian during the training process to empirically validate the theoretical bounds and plot the conditioning dynamics over time.

modules.name: Vision Transformer Architecture Integration
modules.description: Integrates various initialization schemes into diverse Vision Transformer architectures, ensuring compatibility with both standard self-attention mechanisms and modern variants that incorporate query-key normalization.

modules.name: Efficient and Language Transformer Integration
modules.description: Integrates the initialization strategies into efficient attention architectures for long-range sequence tasks, as well as encoder-only and decoder-only language models to validate the method's applicability across attention formulations.

modules.name: Detection and Segmentation Architecture Integration
modules.description: Constructs the object detection and instance segmentation pipeline by combining a customized Transformer backbone with a feature pyramid network and a detection head, applying the specified initialization to the backbone attention layers.

modules.name: Vision Classification Training Pipeline
modules.description: Controls the end-to-end training loop for image classification, managing epoch iterations, forward propagation, loss computation, gradient updates, and optimizer scheduling for various Vision Transformer configurations.

modules.name: Detection and Segmentation Training Pipeline
modules.description: Manages the fine-tuning workflow for object detection and instance segmentation, handling multi-scale feature extraction, region proposal generation, and the computation of combined detection and mask losses.

modules.name: Language and Sequence Training Pipeline
modules.description: Handles the specific training loops for masked language modeling, autoregressive generation, and long-range sequence tasks, incorporating appropriate loss functions and sequence-level evaluation during training.

modules.name: Multi-Task Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Computes comprehensive task-specific evaluation metrics including top-1 classification accuracy, Average Precision for bounding boxes and masks, language model perplexity, and standard natural language understanding benchmark scores.

modules.name: Convergence and Efficiency Analysis
modules.description: Tracks and compares the number of epochs or iterations required by different initialization schemes to reach target performance levels, validating the accelerated convergence property and optimizing computational efficiency.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Study Framework
modules.description: Provides a structured experimental framework to test partial conditioned initializations (e.g., applying the scheme to only a subset of the query, key, or value projections) to validate the joint spectral structure dependency and analyze hyperparameter sensitivity.
